channel.title: heylivo – deadlines & reminders
channel.description: Tips on deadlines in Germany: ID card, car inspection, contracts, doctor, family – and how Livo reminds you in time.

item.title: Done? Just tick it off.
item.description: Livo plans the next date automatically. Car inspection, dentist or insurance: tick off recurring deadlines – Livo remembers the next date right away. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: Tetanus: a booster every 10 years.
item.description: Do you know when you had your last one? Check your vaccination record and add the date to Livo. Livo reminds you when the next booster is due. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: Energy contract ending? Compare now.
item.description: If you don't switch, you often pay more. Add the end date of your electricity or gas contract to Livo. Livo reminds you early enough to compare in peace. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: Never forget a birthday again.
item.description: Livo reminds you a week ahead. Plenty of time for a present or a card. Add it once – Livo reminds you every year. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: Holiday booked – and your passport?
item.description: Many countries require 6 months of validity left. Check how long your passport is valid before every booking. Livo reminds you 6 months ahead – so your new passport arrives in time. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: 30 days free. Then €11.99 a year.
item.description: No subscription, no cancelling, no catch. Try Livo for a month with everything included. After that, Livo Plus costs €11.99 for a whole year – pay once, it doesn't renew automatically. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: Livo speaks 10 languages.
item.description: English, German, Greek, Turkish, Polish and more. Whatever language you speak: Livo understands you and reminds you in your language. Perfect for the whole family. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: When was your last dental check-up?
item.description: Once a year keeps your bonus booklet full. In Germany, a yearly stamp in your bonus booklet (Bonusheft) means a bigger subsidy for dental work later. Livo reminds you every year – you just make the call. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: Car insurance in Germany? Switch by 30 Nov.
item.description: Miss it and you're often tied in for another year. Most German car insurance policies run until 31 December – you have to cancel by 30 November. With Livo you won't miss the window. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: Phone contract over 24 months? Cancel monthly.
item.description: Many people keep overpaying for years. In Germany, after the minimum term you can cancel your phone contract with one month's notice. Add the end date to Livo and compare offers in time. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.

item.title: Forgot your TÜV? That can get expensive.
item.description: In Germany, there's a fine once you're 2 months overdue. The TÜV inspection is due every 2 years, for new cars first after 3 years. Add the month from your sticker to Livo – Livo reminds you in time. Livo reminds you in time: heylivo.com – 30 days free, no sign-up.
